title: Boss: config and data
summary: Generate config, check references, and size storage.

steps.title: The scene
steps.body: Before a release, the platform team wants a pre-flight check: will every pod's config references resolve, what will each container see, and is there storage for every claim? Build it.

steps.title: Check references
prompt: Write `List<string> Missing(List<(string Kind, string Name, string Key)> refs, Dictionary<string, HashSet<string>> configMaps, Dictionary<string, HashSet<string>> secrets)`.
Each ref has `Kind` `"configmap"` or `"secret"`, an object `Name`, and a `Key` (or `""` for a whole-object reference like `envFrom`). Return one line per problem, in input order:
- key missing: `"secret shop-db has no key pasword"`
starter: List<string> Missing(List<(string Kind, string Name, string Key)> refs, Dictionary<string, HashSet<string>> configMaps, Dictionary<string, HashSet<string>> secrets)
solution: List<string> Missing(List<(string Kind, string Name, string Key)> refs, Dictionary<string, HashSet<string>> configMaps, Dictionary<string, HashSet<string>> secrets)
if (!store.TryGetValue(r.Name, out var keys)) problems.Add($"{r.Kind} {r.Name} not found");
else if (r.Key != "" && !keys.Contains(r.Key)) problems.Add($"{r.Kind} {r.Name} has no key {r.Key}");
template: var dojoCms = new Dictionary<string, HashSet<string>> { ["shop-config"] = new() { "LOG_LEVEL", "PAYMENTS_URL" } };
var dojoSecs = new Dictionary<string, HashSet<string>> { ["shop-db"] = new() { "password", "user" } };
Dojo.Eq("all fine", new List<string>(), Missing(new() { ("configmap", "shop-config", ""), ("secret", "shop-db", "password") }, dojoCms, dojoSecs));
Dojo.Eq("problems in order", new List<string> { "secret shop-db has no key pasword", "configmap feature-flags not found", "secret stripe not found" },
Dojo.Eq("a configmap name is not a secret", new List<string> { "secret shop-config not found" }, Missing(new() { ("secret", "shop-config", "") }, dojoCms, dojoSecs));
hints: Pick the right dictionary by `Kind` first.
Object missing beats key missing: check `TryGetValue` before `Contains`.

steps.title: Parse storage quantities
prompt: Kubernetes quantities use binary suffixes `Ki Mi Gi Ti` (powers of 1024) and decimal ones `k M G T` (powers of 1000). Write `long Bytes(string q)` (no suffix means bytes) and `bool Fits(string request, string capacity)`.
solution: var units = new (string Suffix, long Factor)[] {
bool Fits(string request, string capacity) => Bytes(request) <= Bytes(capacity);
hints: Check the two-letter binary suffixes before the one-letter decimal ones (`Gi` ends with `i`, but `G` alone must not match `Gi`).

steps.title: Render a config file
prompt: Teams often mount a templated config file. Write `string Render(string template, Dictionary<string, string> values)` that replaces every `${NAME}` with its value. A name not in `values` throws `KeyNotFoundException` (fail the release, not production). Text without placeholders is returned unchanged.
starter: string Render(string template, Dictionary<string, string> values)
solution: string Render(string template, Dictionary<string, string> values)
